faq_heading: Homes near L.A. Matheson Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the L.A. Matheson Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the L.A. Matheson Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near L.A. Matheson Secondary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near L.A. Matheson Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 229 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,121,000, townhomes $645,000, condos $404,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near L.A. Matheson Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of L.A. Matheson Secondary the median was 34 days on the market, closing at 95.5% of the list price, with 7% of sales above the list price for the 229 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to L.A. Matheson Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Kirkbride Elementary (0.6 km south), Cedar Hills Elementary (0.7 km north-east) and Senator Reid Elementary (0.8 km east).

L.A. Matheson Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 9484 122 St. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions L.A. Matheson Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the L.A. Matheson Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names L.A. Matheson Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of L.A. Matheson Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 229 homes sold within 2 km of L.A. Matheson Secondary: 130 houses, 47 townhomes and 31 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,121,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of L.A. Matheson Secondary

28 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of L.A. Matheson Secondary in a straight line (19 elementary, 7 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Kirkbride Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Delta Continuing Education, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delview Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Devon Gardens Elementary (2.4 km). Other secondary schools close by: Delview Secondary (1.6 km south-west), Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry) (1.8 km south-east), Khalsa Secondary School (Surrey) (2.2 km north), Queen Elizabeth Secondary (2.7 km east), Kwantlen Park Secondary (2.8 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Delview Secondary, 1.6 km south-west of L.A. Matheson Secondary.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of L.A. Matheson Secondary was $1,121,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
